components.title: Agent Skill Library
components.purpose: Delivers reusable agent capabilities as self-contained skill directories with SKILL.md manifests, reference documents, scripts, and templates that agents load on demand to perform specialized tasks.

primary.rationale: Every top-level skill definition and its bundled references, scripts, and templates live here; this directory is the component.

shared.rationale: Authoring scaffolds for new skills and memory templates, also used when a command needs to emit a skill-shaped artifact.

components.title: Slash Command Surface
components.purpose: Delivers namespaced slash commands as markdown files under commands/<namespace>/, including the team orchestration router that selects roles and sequences agent handoffs across the four-layer protocol. The committed tree ships the shipped core; a further family of Super Intelligence commands is generated at install time from the team registries rather than committed, so the installed surface is several times the size of this directory, exactly as docs/asset-counts.json and adapters/INDEX.md record empirically.

primary.rationale: All command definitions plus the /team router, its role registry, and its protocol files live here.

components.title: Bundled Orchestration Systems
components.purpose: Delivers multi-phase project orchestration, knowledge tracking, persona councils spanning a growing set of professional domains, and video generation as optional bundles under systems/, each shipping its own nested skills, agents, personas, and validation scripts that install independently of the core asset set.

primary.rationale: The GSD, brain, cognee, hyperframes, m0, superintelligence, and team bundles, each self-contained with nested skills, agents, personas, and domain-specific registries.

components.title: Subagent Role Definitions
components.purpose: Delivers named subagent roles and behavioural rules that commands dispatch work to, so each role's system prompt is defined once in agents/ and rules/ and reused across every pipeline that spawns it.

primary.rationale: Agent role definitions and the behavioural rule sets they carry; both are dispatched by the command surface rather than invoked directly.

components.title: Multi-Editor Install Adapters
components.purpose: Delivers installation across every editor and CLI adapter under adapters/, including Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and the Copilot CLI, Codex, Grok, Amazon Q, and other AGENTS.md consumers, by mapping skills, commands, and agents into each tool's configuration directory under a per-adapter namespace convention, with a Homebrew formula and bootstrap script for first-time setup.

primary.rationale: One directory per adapter, each holding an install.sh, a manifest.json declaring the surfaces and bundles it supports, and a README. The manifests are the machine-readable contract; scripts/build-delivery-index.py installs every adapter into a throwaway HOME and records what it actually delivered in adapters/INDEX.md.

notes: Structural index only. Component altitude is C4-Container; these paths are not work-assignment boundaries. Build tooling (scripts/), generated catalogs (docs/), CI workflows (.github/), tests (tests/), reference documentation (mcps/), examples (examples/), static assets (assets/, coco/), and website content (index.html, CNAME) are deliberately excluded under the runtime-only rule in references/component-rules.md, so they appear in no component. What each install adapter actually delivers is recorded separately, and empirically, in adapters/INDEX.md, because that question needs running code rather than a directory listing.
